state.fullText: All places are taken. New workshops are added often: take a look!
state.closedText: Registration for this workshop closed on {date}.
state.startedText: Registration is closed. Take a look at the upcoming workshops.
state.pastText: Take a look at the upcoming workshops.
state.cancelledText: We’re sorry. Take a look at the other workshops.
state.pausedTitle: Registration is paused for a moment
state.pausedText: We’re updating a few details. Please check back soon.

register.title: Register

signIn.title: Log in to register
signIn.text: Registering takes a minute. Log in, or create a free account if you’re new here.

verify.title: Please confirm your email first
verify.text: We sent a link to {email}. Open it, then come back here to register.
verify.sent: Sent! Please check your inbox, and the spam folder too.
verify.alreadyVerified: Your email is confirmed. You can register now!

register.participantHint: Their full name, so we can welcome them.
register.childNote: This workshop is for children aged {min, number}–{max, number}. As their parent, please write your child’s name here.
register.termsIntro: Please read the terms before registering.
register.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the registration and cancellation terms.

consent.title: Photos and videos
consent.text: Photos and videos may be taken during the workshop. These choices are only about publishing identifiable images of the participant on the {brand} website and official pages, to show what {brand} does. They are optional and don’t affect registration or attendance. They don’t cover the instructor’s personal pages.
consent.guardian: If the participant is a child, a parent or legal guardian makes these choices.
consent.photo: I agree to the publication of identifiable photos of the participant.
consent.video: I agree to the publication of identifiable videos of the participant.

pay.title: Price
pay.later: You pay after registering. Ways to pay:
pay.none: You pay after registering: we’ll get in touch with you about how.
pay.free: This workshop is free: nothing to pay.

errors.acceptTerms: Please tick this box to register.

errors.notFound: We couldn’t find this. It may have been removed.
errors.notOpen: Registration for this workshop isn’t open right now.
errors.full: Sorry, the last place has just been taken: this workshop is full.
errors.deadline: Sorry, registration for this workshop has closed.
errors.started: This workshop has already started, so registration is closed.
errors.cancelled: This workshop was cancelled, so registration is closed.
errors.duplicate: {name} is already registered for this workshop.
errors.tooMany: You can register up to {max, number} people for one workshop. To register more, please get in touch with us.
errors.termsChanged: The terms were just updated. Please reload the page, read them and register again.
errors.cannotCancel: This registration can’t be cancelled any more.
errors.startedCancel: The workshop has already started, so this registration can’t be cancelled any more.

payment.title: How to pay
payment.intro: {count, plural, one {Please pay {amount} this way:} other {Please pay {amount} in whichever way suits you best:}}
payment.none: We’ll get in touch with you soon about how to pay {amount}.

cash.title: Cash at the workshop
cash.text: Bring {amount} in cash and pay on the day of the workshop.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.copyFailed: We couldn’t copy it. Please select the IBAN and copy it by hand.
transfer.reference: Please write “{name}” in the transfer description, so we know who it’s for.

online.title: Pay online
online.text: Pay {amount} by card on the secure payment page.
online.after: After you pay, our team confirms your payment. It can take a little while.

payment.confirmNote: As soon as we receive your payment, we’ll mark it as paid here and send you an email.

account.title: My workshops
account.subtitle: Your registrations and how to pay, all in one place.
account.emptyTitle: You haven’t registered for a workshop yet
account.emptyText: Find one you love and save your place in a minute.
account.detailsText: Your name, your phone number and the language of our emails.
account.name: Your name
account.passwordText: We’ll email you a link to choose a new password.

cancel.title: Cancel this registration?
cancel.unpaid: The place for {name} will be freed for someone else. You haven’t paid, so there’s nothing else to do.
cancel.full: You paid {paid}. Under the terms you get it all back: we’ll send {refund} back to you within five business days.
cancel.partial: The workshop starts in less than 72 hours, so under the terms you get {percent, number}% back: we’ll send {refund} back to you within five business days.
cancel.none: The workshop starts in less than 24 hours, so under the terms this payment can’t be refunded.
cancel.doneRefund: Your registration is cancelled. We’ll send {refund} back to you within five business days.

detail.welcomeText: We’ve saved a place for {name}. We’ve also emailed you the details.
detail.paidText: We’ve received your payment and your place is confirmed.
detail.freeText: Your place is confirmed. There’s nothing to pay.
